journal.text: Morning of day 2. Wolves west, villagers all about. Chatting with Ben first.
Ben was too busy to talk. Going for berries.
Ate, hunger good. Now to the water.
Drunk fully. Berries next, for the household.
Kai looked hungry; I have berries to give.
Kai thanked me with news of a clay pit. Arlo now looks hungry.
Arlo too busy to take my berries. Picking more.
Pack full of berries. Inviting Emre to eat.

A wasted afternoon: the hut would not be marked out. Now to keep my word to Emre.
Late; the meal had lapsed. Telling Emre plainly.
Emre had no ear for me. Taking berries home.
Home at last. Eat, then sleep.

journal.text: Morning of day 2. Wolves west, villagers all about. Chatting with Ben first.
Ben was too busy to talk. Going for berries.
Ate, hunger good. Now to the water.
Drunk fully. Berries next, for the household.
Kai looked hungry; I have berries to give.
Kai thanked me with news of a clay pit. Arlo now looks hungry.
Arlo too busy to take my berries. Picking more.
Pack full of berries. Inviting Emre to eat.
Emre agreed to eat with me at the fire this evening. I'll start my hut meanwhile.
A wasted afternoon: the hut would not be marked out. Now to keep my word to Emre.
Late; the meal had lapsed. Telling Emre plainly.
Emre had no ear for me. Taking berries home.
Home at last. Eat, then sleep.
Night of day 2. Sleeping at my lean-to.
Awake in the night, thirsty. Going to the shore.
Watered. Off to the bushes in the dark.
Cold and alone in the dark. Taking berries home.
Home store now has 2 berries. Waiting out the dark.
Dawn of day 3. To my field.
Kai still hungry. I'll finish what I owed him.
Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.

journal.text: Morning of day 2. Wolves west, villagers all about. Chatting with Ben first.
Ben was too busy to talk. Going for berries.
Ate, hunger good. Now to the water.
Drunk fully. Berries next, for the household.
Kai looked hungry; I have berries to give.
Kai thanked me with news of a clay pit. Arlo now looks hungry.
Arlo too busy to take my berries. Picking more.
Pack full of berries. Inviting Emre to eat.
Emre agreed to eat with me at the fire this evening. I'll start my hut meanwhile.
A wasted afternoon: the hut would not be marked out. Now to keep my word to Emre.
Late; the meal had lapsed. Telling Emre plainly.
Emre had no ear for me. Taking berries home.
Home at last. Eat, then sleep.
Night of day 2. Sleeping at my lean-to.
Awake in the night, thirsty. Going to the shore.
Watered. Off to the bushes in the dark.
Cold and alone in the dark. Taking berries home.
Home store now has 2 berries. Waiting out the dark.
Dawn of day 3. To my field.
Kai still hungry. I'll finish what I owed him.
Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.

journal.text: Morning of day 2. Wolves west, villagers all about. Chatting with Ben first.
Ben was too busy to talk. Going for berries.
Ate, hunger good. Now to the water.
Drunk fully. Berries next, for the household.
Kai looked hungry; I have berries to give.
Kai thanked me with news of a clay pit. Arlo now looks hungry.
Arlo too busy to take my berries. Picking more.
Pack full of berries. Inviting Emre to eat.
Emre agreed to eat with me at the fire this evening. I'll start my hut meanwhile.
A wasted afternoon: the hut would not be marked out. Now to keep my word to Emre.
Late; the meal had lapsed. Telling Emre plainly.
Emre had no ear for me. Taking berries home.
Home at last. Eat, then sleep.
Night of day 2. Sleeping at my lean-to.
Awake in the night, thirsty. Going to the shore.
Watered. Off to the bushes in the dark.
Cold and alone in the dark. Taking berries home.
Home store now has 2 berries. Waiting out the dark.
Dawn of day 3. To my field.
Kai still hungry. I'll finish what I owed him.
Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food; the south has fish and grain, fruit trees 971-973 are now picked out.
Stay among friends; feed hungry neighbours (Ivy hungry now); thank Zia for the fish; Kai owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (9 W of the lean-to): wood complete; it lacks 3 stone. Stone sources: Cora (carries some, swap offered), outcrop 1080 (8, west of the fruit trees), 1084 (5, SW).
Bring my field plot 1243 (83% grown) to harvest; it is next to my lean-to.

intentions.text: Go warm at the fire 10 NE (warmth 24). Then see who is there; ask about Ivy; offer my last fruit if someone is hungry. Later: stone for hut site 3242 (4 W of here); outcrop 1072 is 13 NW.

inferences.text: Warmth fell 39 to 24 in 1h in rain at 1-2C; the lean-to only keeps rain off, the fire is what warms. Eating did not stop the fall.
The eat option ate everything (fish and fruit) despite my asking for two portions; I cannot ration meals through this answer.

uncertainties.text: Where is Ivy? Last seen about (38.7,42.5) 3 h ago, near the fire.
Where did the stored-food number go: it shows 30/30 and looks like my own belly, not the lean-to store (1 berry).

journal.text: Watered. Off to the bushes in the dark.
Cold and alone in the dark. Taking berries home.
Home store now has 2 berries. Waiting out the dark.
Dawn of day 3. To my field.
Kai still hungry. I'll finish what I owed him.
Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.

proposal.why: I am warm and fed again, and I owe grain to Viktor and Kai. My field is 85% grown and close, while the grain to the east lies near the wolves that still loiter there.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food (berry, grain, fish all picked out near camp). Fruit trees 971-973 far SW are picked out too.
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. KEEP MY PROMISES: 2 grain to Viktor and 2 grain to Kai (due in ~16 h). Kai also owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (13 W): wood done, it lacks 3 stone. Stone: outcrop 1071 (16 W), 1072 (20 W). Plan is set aside while 'a wolf is about'.
Bring my field plot 1243 (85% grown, 4 SW) to harvest: it is my grain for the promises.

intentions.text: Tend field 1243 now. When ripe, harvest, then carry 2 grain each to Viktor and Kai. Avoid the east: two wolves stay near (44,44). Stone for the hut later.

uncertainties.text: Where is Ivy? Nico says Ivy looked hungry 4 h ago.
Where did the stored-food number go: it shows 30/30 and looks like my own belly, not the lean-to store (1 berry).

inferences.text: Two wolves sit near (44,44), 6-7 tiles SE-E of the fire, for 17 h now, yet people go about calmly. Not in DANGERS, but my hut plan is held by a wolf.
One choice can swallow hours: warming at the fire took 03:25 to 10:59, and promises to Kai and Viktor were made for me in that time.

notes.journal: Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food (berry, grain, fish all picked out near camp). Fruit trees 971-973 far SW are picked out too.
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. KEEP MY PROMISES: 2 grain to Viktor and 2 grain to Kai (due in ~16 h). Kai also owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (13 W): wood done, it lacks 3 stone. Stone: outcrop 1071 (16 W), 1072 (20 W). Plan is set aside while 'a wolf is about'.
Bring my field plot 1243 (85% grown, 4 SW) to harvest: it is my grain for the promises.

intentions.text: Offer Ben water for stone at the fire (8 NE). If it works, carry stone to hut site 3242 (8 W). Field 1243 is 91% (grows ~1%/h; tending gave +5%): harvest grain for Viktor and Kai before they fall due

inferences.text: Fetching water produced no option to water my field (tend vanished at 90%). Tending gave about +5%, natural growth about 1% per hour.

uncertainties.text: Where is Ivy? Nico says Ivy looked hungry 4 h ago.
Where did the stored-food number go: it shows 30/30 and looks like my own belly, not the lean-to store (1 berry).

journal.text: Dawn of day 3. To my field.
Kai still hungry. I'll finish what I owed him.
Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food (berry, grain, fish all picked out near camp). Fruit trees 971-973 far SW are picked out too.
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. KEEP MY PROMISES: 2 grain to Viktor and 2 grain to Kai (due in ~16 h). Kai also owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (13 W): wood done, it lacks 3 stone. Stone: outcrop 1071 (16 W), 1072 (20 W). Plan is set aside while 'a wolf is about'.
Bring my field plot 1243 (85% grown, 4 SW) to harvest: it is my grain for the promises.

intentions.text: Gather wild grain at 990 (10 E, hoping it regrew; 992 and 989 nearby). Carry it to Viktor and Kai (due in ~13 h). If wolves move or bite, turn back west. Field 1243 is 91%.

inferences.text: People stood on or beside the 'wolf' tiles (43-45, 43-45) for hours without harm (Viktor, Abel, Lena). Maybe the wolves are no threat now; still, I am wary.

uncertainties.text: Where is Ivy? Nico says Ivy looked hungry 4 h ago.
Where did the stored-food number go: it shows 30/30 and looks like my own belly, not the lean-to store (1 berry).

journal.text: Lean season. Eating my last berries before the fruit trek.
Fed (hunger 66). Berries to the north-west.
Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.

Stay among friends and feed the hungry. PROMISES: 2 grain to Viktor, 2 to Kai (due in ~12 h). I have 1 grain only; wild grain here is picked clean. Kai owes me 2 berries.

Bring my field plot 1243 (91% grown) to harvest: my real source of grain for the promises.

journal.text: Four berries in hand. Home first.
Store stocked. Trying for a hut again.
The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.

journal.text: The hut site is marked. Fruit first, then timber and stone.
Belly fuller. Asking Zia for a hand with the hut.
Zia too busy. Chopping wood for the hut.
Two wood in my arms. Walking to the hut site.
Ines lent a hand with the hut. Delivering my wood.
Wood nearly done; stone is the trouble. Drink first.
Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.

13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.

plans.step: get 3 stone for the hut (it wants 3 stone)

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food (berry, grain, fish all picked out near camp).
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. PROMISES: 1 more grain to Viktor, 2 to Kai (due in ~10 h). Wild grain is picked clean. Kai owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (8 W of here): it lacks 3 stone. Stone: outcrop 1073 (10 W) is probably bare; 1163 (22 E, 37 stone) is rich but far.
Harvest field 1243 (96%, 2 NE) when ripe: my real grain for the promises. Tend new plot 5170 (seeded 17:30).

intentions.text: Drink at well 3036 (7 SW). Then walk to my field 1243 and harvest if ripe; owe 1 grain to Viktor (hungry child at the fire), 2 to Kai (due ~7 h). Seeds 2 left; check new plot 5170.

inferences.text: Eating one fruit raised hunger 39 to 55 (about +16). A fruit is a real meal now.

uncertainties.text: Is Viktor's household the one at lean-to 1105 (owner Briar)? Will they find the grain?

journal.text: Drank. Chopping the last wood for the hut.
Wood chopped. Fruit now; the stone must wait.
Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food. Fruit trees 971-973 (SW) are bare again; berry bushes bare. Better: wild grain 994-996 (12 S) and fishing 1098 (11 S), seen full 2 days ago.
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. PROMISES: 1 more grain to Viktor, 2 to Kai (due ~7 h). Kai owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (6 N of here): it lacks 3 stone. Near outcrops are bare; 1163 (E, 37 stone) is far.
Harvest field 1243 near lean-to 1115 (96% at 17:21 day 5) and tend new plot 5170 (seeded).

intentions.text: Gather wild grain at 996 (12 S), eat some if hungry, carry the rest home for Viktor and Kai (13+12 tiles north-east). Perhaps fish at 1098 nearby too. Then find field 1243.

inferences.text: Fruit trees 971-973 gave nothing after 2 days: they do not recover quickly when the camp strips them.

uncertainties.text: Is Viktor's household the one at lean-to 1105 (owner Briar)? Will they find the grain?

journal.text: Two fruit in hand; eating them.
Fed. Hauling the last wood to the hut.
Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.

goals.text: Keep fed and watered; the camp is short of food. Fruit trees 971-973 (SW) are bare again; berry bushes bare. Better: wild grain 994-996 (12 S) and fishing 1098 (11 S), seen full 2 days ago.
Stay among friends and feed the hungry. PROMISES: 1 more grain to Viktor, 2 to Kai (due ~7 h). Kai owes me 2 berries.
Finish my hut at site 3242 (6 N of here): it lacks 3 stone. Near outcrops are bare; 1163 (E, 37 stone) is far.
Harvest field 1243 near lean-to 1115 (96% at 17:21 day 5) and tend new plot 5170 (seeded).

journal.text: Hut has all its wood. Resting before the stone.
Dusk of day 3. Going home to sleep.
Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.

journal.text: Day 4, night. Drinking at the well.
Cold night, awake. Off to break stone.
One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.

journal.text: One stone in the pack, cold in the bones. Home to the lean-to.
Home, many neighbours awake. Asking Cole for stone.
Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.

journal.text: Cole would not give stone. Going to make my peace with Emre.
Emre forgave the lapsed meal. Carrying stone west, toward the fruit trees.
One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.

journal.text: One stone delivered, three to go. Hungry; off for fruit.
Zia's fish filled me. Drinking before the stone trip.
Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.

journal.text: Fed and watered. Asking Ines for a hand with the hut.
Ines busy but kind. Fishing in the south.
One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.
18:47 day 6 dusk. Ines refused my fish ('more pressing needs') yet we passed time together. Social is full. Going to drink.
19:11 day 6, dark. Drank, social full. The only bed offered is my lean-to, 12 tiles west; going there.

journal.text: One fish. Fruit next, then north again.
New stone found to the west. Eating to clear my pack.
Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.

Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.

11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.
18:47 day 6 dusk. Ines refused my fish ('more pressing needs') yet we passed time together. Social is full. Going to drink.
19:11 day 6, dark. Drank, social full. The only bed offered is my lean-to, 12 tiles west; going there.

journal.text: Too full to eat, too laden for stone. Home to my field.
Evening of day 4. Offering Cora fruit for stone.
Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.
18:47 day 6 dusk. Ines refused my fish ('more pressing needs') yet we passed time together. Social is full. Going to drink.
19:11 day 6, dark. Drank, social full. The only bed offered is my lean-to, 12 tiles west; going there.
03:04 day 7. Slept at my lean-to without harm. Fire is out. Harvesting the last grain.
03:36 day 7. Pack: 3 grain, 1 fish, 4 seeds. Trying grain for stone with hungry Cora.
04:07 day 7. Cora, asleep, declined: 'more pressing needs'. Sowing my seeds instead.
04:51 day 7. Sowed. Offering fish to awake, hungry Cole.

journal.text: Evening day 4. Cora had no stone to spare. Wolves SE; taking fish west to Ivy.
Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.
18:47 day 6 dusk. Ines refused my fish ('more pressing needs') yet we passed time together. Social is full. Going to drink.
19:11 day 6, dark. Drank, social full. The only bed offered is my lean-to, 12 tiles west; going there.
03:04 day 7. Slept at my lean-to without harm. Fire is out. Harvesting the last grain.
03:36 day 7. Pack: 3 grain, 1 fish, 4 seeds. Trying grain for stone with hungry Cora.
04:07 day 7. Cora, asleep, declined: 'more pressing needs'. Sowing my seeds instead.
04:51 day 7. Sowed. Offering fish to awake, hungry Cole.
04:55 day 7. Cole too busy for my fish. Taking the food to my own store.
05:14 day 7. One grain stored. Walking to hungry Emre with my fish.

journal.text: Dusk day 4. Ivy was not where I expected. Going to sleep at the lean-to.
Woke at 02:23 in the rain, cold and thirsty. Many neighbours look hungry. Drinking at the well.
03:07 night. Drank my fill. Cold (27) and hungry (45). Eating, then the fire.
03:25. Full belly, full of water, cold to the bone. Walking to the fire.
Morning of day 5, 10:59. Warm again, but hours slipped by at the fire and I find I promised grain to Viktor and Kai. Tending my field.
11:29. Field at 90 percent. Fetching water for it.
12:15. Pack holds 2 water. No way to pour it on the field, so I try it as a trade for stone with Ben.
13:35. Ben has nothing to spare. Drinking my water to clear my pack for grain.
13:40. Walking east for wild grain, past the two wolves everyone ignores.
15:01. East grain gave me one handful only. Taking it to Viktor's lean-to. The wolves did nothing.
15:53. Left 1 grain at Viktor's lean-to (1 of 2). Going home to break ground and sow seeds.
17:21. Ground broken beside my lean-to. Sowing seed. My old field is at 96%.
17:33. Sowed one seed (2 left). Tending the new plot; the old field is not tendable now.
17:46 dusk. Fire nearly out. Going to chop wood for it.
18:50. Two logs in my pack. The camp fire is dead; walking over to feed it.
20:00. Fed the fire; ten neighbours asleep round it. I sleep here.
02:04 day 6. Awake in rain, hungry (39). Eating my last fruit by the fire.
02:10. Fed, rested, thirsty. Staying by the fire until light.
06:00 day 6. Light, rain, 5C. Thirst 36, hunger 43. Going to the well, then my field.
07:06 day 6. Drank. Hungry (40), cold (49), rain. Off to the fruit trees SW.
07:53 day 6. Fruit trees empty. Going south to the wild grain.
09:16 day 6. One grain only; Ines was here before me. Fishing next, then north with food.
09:52 day 6. Hunger forced me to eat my one grain. Fishing 3 fish to carry home.
10:54 day 6. Three fish in the pack. Eating one, carrying the rest north.
11:06 day 6. Full at last (two fish eaten, one left). Heading home for the grain I owe.
14:05 day 6. Back near the camp. The field is ripe; harvesting for my promises.
15:07 day 6. Harvested 4 grain. Going to pay my promises.
15:44 day 6. Viktor's promise paid. On to Kai's.
16:28 day 6. Both promises paid. A wolf near; going to warn Tomas.
16:48 day 6. Tomas too busy. Jax seeks company; warning him.
17:43 day 6. Warned Jax; he told me Kai is hungry. Offering my fish to Ines, who is in sight.
18:47 day 6 dusk. Ines refused my fish ('more pressing needs') yet we passed time together. Social is full. Going to drink.
19:11 day 6, dark. Drank, social full. The only bed offered is my lean-to, 12 tiles west; going there.
03:04 day 7. Slept at my lean-to without harm. Fire is out. Harvesting the last grain.
03:36 day 7. Pack: 3 grain, 1 fish, 4 seeds. Trying grain for stone with hungry Cora.
04:07 day 7. Cora, asleep, declined: 'more pressing needs'. Sowing my seeds instead.
04:51 day 7. Sowed. Offering fish to awake, hungry Cole.
04:55 day 7. Cole too busy for my fish. Taking the food to my own store.
05:14 day 7. One grain stored. Walking to hungry Emre with my fish.
06:06 day 7. My fish reached Emre. Now to tell Kai his grain waits.
